title: KYC and Credit/Business Support Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**KYC and Credit/Business Support Analyst**
-------------------------------------------

**Industry:** Banking / Financial Services

**Base Location:** GIFT City, Gandhinagar

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The KYC and Credit/Business Support Analyst will support the banks customer due diligence, KYC compliance, loan and facility administration, transaction processing, and day-to-day business support activities. The role requires close coordination with customers, relationship teams, Compliance and Operations to ensure accurate documentation, timely processing, and adherence to internal policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Conduct due diligence for new customers, perform screening, request KYC information, review documents, and update customer records in the KYC workflow system.
* Complete periodic KYC reviews, Re-KYC, customer updates and ad-hoc reviews; follow up with customers to obtain outstanding or updated documentation.
* Conduct enhanced due diligence on high-risk customers, including politically exposed persons (PEPs), in line with applicable policies and procedures.
* Coordinate with internal Compliance and Operations teams to obtain approvals, submit required documents, and address customer or account-related queries.
* Process loan and other banking-product transactions, including preparation of instruction sheets, quarterly rollovers and coordination with customers or agents.
* Prepare and maintain MIS reports, internal and external presentations, pitch books, instruction sheets and other business-support documentation.
* Coordinate with customers and internal stakeholders on front-office requirements, document execution, submission and transaction follow-through.
* Maintain facility records, internal custody documents, control books and ancillary documentation; support covenant-compliance tracking under facility agreements.
* Ensure all activities comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies and the banks head-office guidelines.
* Undertake other responsibilities assigned by the team head or GIFT City branch head.

**Required Experience & Skills**
--------------------------------

* Relevant experience in the banking domain is mandatory.
* Hands-on exposure to KYC, customer due diligence, AML screening, periodic reviews and customer documentation.
* Understanding of loan operations, credit administration, facility documentation or banking transaction processing is preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to liaise professionally with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Good coordination, documentation, follow-up, accuracy and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage sensitive customer information and work in accordance with compliance and control requirements.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------

Candidates who combine KYC and due-diligence knowledge with loan/facility administration or corporate banking support experience. Strong client communication and stakeholder-management skills are essential.

title: Finance and Account Executive
description:
Experience:

3-5 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably in a manufacturing/plant

environment.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced Finance & Accounts professional to manage the day-to-day

finance operations of the plant. The role involves month-end closing, plant P&L preparation,

vendor payments, customer collections, and inventory accounting.

The position will also be responsible for GST, TDS, and TCS compliance and timely coordination

with Head Office.

The candidate will act as a key finance contact for vendors, customers, auditors, and plant

management.

Software Skills

 SAP – Hands-on experience is preferred.

 Good working knowledge of MS Excel and other MS Office applications.

Key Responsibilities

1. Month-End Closing & Reporting

o Manage month-end closing activities for the plant and coordinate with Head

Office for timely closure of monthly books.

o Prepare and submit monthly Plant Profit & Loss (P&L) statements and related

financial reports.

o Ensure accuracy and timely completion of accounting entries and reconciliations.

2. Vendor & Customer Accounting

o Coordinate with vendors and customers regarding accounting, invoicing, payment,

and collection-related matters.

o Act as the single point of contact for resolving accounting and payment-related

issues.

o Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely availability and supply of materials.

3. Purchase & Invoice Accounting

o Verify invoices against purchase orders, GRNs, and supporting documents.

o Ensure proper accounting and documentation of all transactions.

4. Vendor Payments

o Prepare and maintain the vendor payment schedule based on due dates,

priorities, and available funds.

o Coordinate with HO/Finance for timely processing of vendor payments.

o Monitor outstanding vendor balances and resolve discrepancies.

5. Customer Collections

o Prepare the customer collection plan and monitor outstanding receivables.

o Follow up with sales team for timely collections and ensure adherence to agreed

payment terms.

o Coordinate with the sales/commercial team to resolve collection-related issues.

6. GST Compliance

o Prepare and file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B on a monthly basis for three plants.

o Complete necessary GST reconciliations before filing returns.

o Coordinate with auditors for preparation and filing of GSTR-9.

o Ensure timely compliance with applicable GST requirements.

7. TDS & TCS Compliance

o Prepare and provide TDS and TCS-related details to Head Office within the

stipulated timelines.

o Coordinate with HO for necessary reconciliations and compliance requirements.

8. Petty Cash Management

o Maintain and manage petty cash for plant-related expenses.

o Ensure proper supporting documents, approvals, and timely accounting of petty

cash transactions.

o Conduct regular petty cash verification and reconciliation.

9. Plant Coordination & Administration

 Coordinate with the Plant Head on finance, HR, and administration-related matters.

 Support the plant management team in resolving financial and administrative issues.

 Coordinate with HO and other internal departments as required.

Key Skills & Competencies

 Strong knowledge of plant accounting and financial processes.

 Good understanding of GST, TDS, and TCS compliance.

 Hands-on experience in month-end closing, P&L preparation, vendor payments, and

customer collections.

 Strong analytical and reconciliation skills.

 Good communication and interpersonal skills.

 Ability to coordinate effectively with HO, vendors, customers, auditors, and plant teams.

 Strong attention to detail and ability to meet statutory and reporting deadlines.

 Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with 3-5 years of experience in Finance & Accounts within a manufacturing/plant

environment will be preferred, particularly those with hands-on experience in SAP and GST

compliance.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,537.02 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Accounts Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
**Company**

Ishitva aims at solving one of the biggest challenges faced by the world currently, which is sorting and recycling of Plastic and other Dry Waste. We build automation solutions for waste management industry using industry 4.0 tools, including Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and IoT. Our solutions use computer vision to make sorting of waste more efficient at different stages of the waste value chain. With a futuristic vision of revolutionising the recycling industry, today we provide solutions for automated picking, sorting, and segregation of dry waste including plastics.

Ishitva is recognised as top 10 leading AI based start-ups in the country and we are looking to build a team of young and energetic members who will work towards creating innovative solutions for some of the most urgent and important issues faced by the world. We are building a diverse team of professionals, engineers and environment enthusiasts to help us transform the waste management practices across the country.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Maintain day-to-day accounting records in the ERP/accounting software..
* Record purchase, sales, receipt, payment, and journal vouchers accurately.
* Monitor accounts receivable and accounts payable and follow up on outstanding balances.
* Process vendor payments and customer receipts.
* Prepare monthly ledger reconciliations and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain fixed asset registers and calculate depreciation.
* Ensure proper accounting of inventory transactions and stock reconciliation. Prepare monthly Trial Balance, Profit & Loss Account, and Balance Sheet.
* Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing.
* Calculate and deduct TDS, prepare TDS returns, and reconcile Form 26AS/TRACES. Prepare GST workings, reconcile GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and GSTR-2B, and support GST return filing.
* Maintain statutory records and ensure compliance with applicable tax laws. Coordinate with auditors during statutory, tax, internal, and bank audits.
* Prepare schedules and supporting documents required for audits.
* Maintain proper documentation and filing of accounting records.
* Assist in budgeting, MIS reports, and cash flow statements.
* Monitor cash and bank balances and prepare daily fund position reports.
* Ensure compliance with company accounting policies and internal controls.
* Support management by providing financial analysis and timely reports.

**Requirements of a successful candidate**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Finance, or Accounting; CA/CMA qualification preferred
* 3 to 6 years of experience in Finance, Accounts, Taxation, Audit, and Financial Management
* Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax, Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and Statutory Compliance
* Experience in cash flow management, working capital planning, banking operations, and fund management
* Proficiency in ERP systems such as Tally, SAP, Oracle, or similar accounting software
* Strong analytical, leadership, audit coordination, risk management, and decision-making skills with the ability to support business growth and profitability objectives.

**Benefits**

* Pick-up Drop facility from office to plant
* Accident Insurance

Pay: From ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have any manufacturing company experience

Work Location: In person

title: Deputy Manager - Finance & Accounts
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**Financial Planning \& Forecasting**


* Lead annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, and rolling forecast processes for assigned business units or functions.
* Develop and maintain driver‑based financial models for revenue, margins, headcount, Opex, and Capex.
* Identify risks and opportunities through proactive financial analysis and scenario planning.


**Performance Management \& Analysis**


* Analyze actuals versus budget, forecast, and prior periods to identify key performance drivers.
* Provide clear and concise financial commentary and insights to senior management.
* Monitor business KPIs and link operational performance with financial outcomes.


**Management Reporting \& MIS**


* Prepare and review monthly management reports, dashboards, and executive presentations.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of financial data used for reporting.
* Standardize and automate MIS reporting using advanced analytical tools.


**Business Partnering**


* Act as a finance business partner to functional leaders (Sales, Operations, HR, Technology, etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives through what‑if analysis, ROI assessments, and profitability analysis.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives and support productivity improvement programs.


**Month\-End \& Close Support**


* Partner with accounting teams to validate actuals, accruals, and allocations from an FP\&A perspective.
* Ensure alignment between management reporting and statutory financials.


**Process Improvement \& Transformation**


* Drive standardization, simplification, and automation of FP\&A processes.
* Support finance transformation initiatives, system enhancements, and reporting automation.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the FP\&A function.


**Team Leadership (if applicable)**


* Guide, review, and mentor FP\&A analysts.
* Ensure quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of outputs.

### **Qualifications**


**Educational Qualifications**


* CA / CMA / MBA (Finance) preferred
* M.Com with strong FP\&A experience may be considered

### **Experience**


* 5–10 years of relevant experience in **FP\&A / Business Finance / Management Reporting**
* Experience in **GCC, Shared Services, or Corporate FP\&A** environments preferred
* Hands‑on exposure to budgeting, forecasting, and business partnering
* Prior experience in stakeholder management and cross‑functional collaboration
